detached_structure.evidence: A separate dark-roofed building sits south of the main house, partly hidden by trees. It could also be an attached wing or part of a neighboring lot.
detached_structure.detail: Possible outbuilding or garage south of the main house

signals.notes: The central house has a dark, multi-section roof in heavy shadow, and large mature trees shade much of the yard on the east and south sides. A blue vehicle is parked near the west side of the house, and a white car is on the neighboring driveway to the north.
